integrity: Proof and independently executable standard-library finite-level tests are provided; finite computations do not establish infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Periodic-base omega limits only. Globally Lipschitz ambient maps but no common Lipschitz bound, no differentiability or global attractivity; measure ratios only for positive dimension, no shape-wise completeness. Historical equivalence remains possible; no independent validation.
title: Dimension rigidity and measure freedom in Lipschitz cyclic omega sections
